settings.a_fixed_shape_keeps_the_page_from_moving: A fixed shape keeps the page from moving while it loads. Phones above the size limit (shop setting mobileCapMb, default 80 MB) get a link to the full viewer.
settings.add_them_to_the_cart_current_variant: Add them to the cart (current variant)
settings.after_the_page_has_loaded_when_in_view: After the page has loaded, when in view
settings.buyers_pick_elements_in_the_3d_view_and: Buyers pick elements in the 3D view and set quantities. The cart keeps each element's GlobalId as a line item property.
settings.csv_element_list_made_in_the_browser: CSV element list made in the browser
settings.empty_finds_the_page_s_contact_form: Empty finds the page's contact form.
settings.empty_uses_ifcvo_config_varianthighlight: Empty uses ifcvo.config variantHighlightKey, then ifc_highlight.
settings.empty_uses_ifcvo_config_variantviewkey_t: Empty uses ifcvo.config variantViewKey, then ifc_view.
settings.empty_uses_the_theme_s_button_colour: Empty uses the theme's button colour.
settings.every_metafield_in_this_namespace_shows: Every metafield in this namespace shows as a row (dimensions, U-value, fire rating…). Leave empty to hide.
settings.fill_the_contact_form_on_this_page: Fill the contact form on this page
settings.heading: Heading
settings.kiosk_model_only_pair_with_the_explorer: Kiosk (model only, pair with the explorer block)
settings.list_of_files_or_urls_in_the_same_namesp: List of files or URLs in the same namespace: RFA, DWG, datasheet PDF…
settings.log_in_to_see_the_downloads: Log in to see the downloads
settings.no_elements_yet_select_one_in_the_3d_vie: No elements yet. Select one in the 3D view.
settings.on_click_keeps_the_product_page_as_fast: On click keeps the product page as fast as without the viewer.
settings.opens_the_3d_viewer_to_build_the_file_on: Opens the 3D viewer to build the file on the visitor's device.
settings.optional_a_saved_scene_brings_its_own_mo: Optional. A saved scene brings its own models, camera and layers.
settings.per_variant_camera_and_highlighted_eleme: Per-variant camera and highlighted elements for the "Product IFC model" block. Variant metafields: custom.ifc_view ("top", {"view":"iso"} or {"position":[x,y,z],"target":[x,y,z]}) and custom.ifc_highlight ("IfcBeam", GlobalIds or {"classes":[],"guids":[]}).
settings.place_the_model_on_the_map: Place the model on the map
settings.please_send_me_a_quote_for_these_element: Please send me a quote for these elements:
settings.reads_the_ifc_file_from_a_product_or_var: Reads the IFC file from a product or variant metafield (URL or file). A variant without its own file shows the product's.
settings.selection_and_buttons_inside_the_viewer: Selection and buttons inside the viewer.
settings.show_a_download_link_for_the_ifc_file: Show a download link for the IFC file
settings.show_a_frame_around_the_block: Show a frame around the block
settings.show_the_floor_plan_beside_the_model: Show the floor plan beside the model
settings.text_when_the_list_is_empty: Text when the list is empty
settings.this_hides_the_links_it_does_not_protect: This hides the links, it does not protect the files: anyone with a file's link can still download it.
settings.https_link_to_an_ifc_file_several_links: https link to an .ifc file. Several links separated by commas load as one federated model.
